say_intro: 약 30도 열대 바다, 마실 물 없이 뗏목에서 며칠 버틸까요?

why.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human figure sitting alone on a small inflatable raft on open tropical sea, translucent glass-like body with glowing veins and organs inside

beats.say: 빠르면 15분, 자외선이 피부를 상하게 해요. 물에 반사까지 돼요.
beats.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human figure lying on a small raft under strong sunlight, translucent glass-like body with a glowing outer skin layer over the shoulders in the center
beats.label: 피부

beats.say: 바닷물은 무게의 약 3.5%가 소금이에요. 갈증을 못 풀어요.
beats.img: a block of ocean water with a quarter wedge cut away, tiny white salt crystals dissolved throughout the clear blue water in the center
beats.label: 녹은 소금

beats.say: 하루 약 1L가 필요한데, 바닷물을 마시면 콩팥이 더 많이 내보내요.
beats.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human figure seen from the back, translucent glass-like body with two glowing kidneys in the center of the lower back
beats.label: 콩팥

verdict.say: 몸속 물 15~20%를 잃으면 위험해요. 더운 곳은 빠르면 3일.
verdict.img: a smooth featureless mannequin-like human figure curled up on a small raft, translucent glass-like body with dim faded glowing veins and shrunken organs in the center
verdict.label: 몸속 물

caption: 사방이 바닷물인데 며칠 버틸까? 🌊
